'''Imperial Extermination Camp 28''' on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] was an extermination camp set up after the [[Massacre of New Coral City]] during the [[Second Imperial Civil War]]. The [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] imprisoned there were forced to perform pointless tasks and locked inside a cage without any food and were expected to die of disease and starvation. However, the prisoners were rendered lifeless husks after [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azard]] and [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] [[Vul Isen]] [[Massacre on Soheras Trench|unleashed]] a [[Sea Leviathan]] upon them.
